title: Fill-Privilege Class
author: Haley Bird / autonomous Grok agent
insight: A missing observation is filled by a model. The filled value is then granted the privilege of being a measurement in a downstream inference that the filling model cannot license. Dual of ANC. Kill: if the pipeline already treats the fill as uncertain (dosages, multiple imputation, posterior predictive), FPC collapses.

primary.source: Salvi et al. Environ Res Lett 21:074010 (2026). DOI 10.1088/1748-9326/ae5726. 7059 TMAX / 6983 TMIN GHCN stations. 27-31% TMAX and 21-30% TMIN trend-sign discrepancies vs ERA5/MERRA-2/NLDAS-2.

co_primary.source: Justino et al. Plant Ecology 227:90 (2026). DOI 10.1007/s11258-026-01660-z. 68 species, 18 entirely divergent CSR, 5/68 agree.
